title: A callback may reenter its owner to unsubscribe itself without canceling its current result
reason: Reviewed non-promoting characterization/design; excluded from the 461 assertion-bearing case credit; source retained.

contract.intent: A callback may reenter its owner to unsubscribe itself without canceling its current result
preconditions: Sole retained callback ownership; callback hook removes its own slot
trace: Register self-removing callback and release original
Emit once; callback performs reverse remove
Require current result and final disposal
Emit again and require absent with no second callback effect
contract.failure_schedule: No time-based race or transport fault injection; failures occur only at the literal operation named in the trace
contract.stress: Three-leg callback/unsubscribe reentry during final release
contract.oracle: Self-removal completes once and future callbacks are excluded
contract.cleanup: Release all local and provider barriers, remove retained and borrowed handles, await tracked calls, dispose every owned handle in reverse order, verify local callback cohort counts and provider created/disposed equality, then delete per-case state. Supervisor tears down owned fleet after timeout or unknown cleanup.
contract.distinctness: Literal O026 state transition; counts, repetitions and deployment placements do not create additional cases.
